Name: Lycanvam Growth
Information:
**Lycanvam**

Lycanvam are dangerous alien plants that take root on planets across the cosmos, as well as seed themselves on drifting comets and space debris. They are voracious, looking to devour any life they can get their tendrils around, and have a unique ability that lets them share the traits and qualities of the creatures they are consuming, often making them resistant to the escape attempts of their prey.

**Silent Slumber.** When a lycanvam growth runs out of food to consume, it will regress into its seedling state (a mossy growth that secures itself in small, tucked-away spaces) and enters into a state of deathly hibernation until it feels the warmth of blood and life around it. It then reawakens and attempts to feed in a wild frenzy. In this suspended state it can exist for hundreds of thousands of years, resembles regular plantlife, and can survive huge impacts, such as a derelict astradeck or meteor crashing down to a planet.

traits.name: Bodily Strength
traits.description: The growth may use its Constitution in place of Strength for any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes, and when forced to make a Strength saving throw it may make a Constitution saving throw instead.

actions.name: Lashing Vines
actions.description: The growth’s body twists and shifts, lashing out at each creature it chooses within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage on a failure. Any creature who fails by 5 points or more is grappled and restrained (escape DC 17). If this attack targets a creature who is already grappled by the growth, they fail automatically, and take an additional 6 (1d10) acid damage.

actions.name: Paralyzed Sporecloud (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The growth shakes, releasing nerve-shocking spores in a 25-foot cube centered on itself. Each non-plant creature within that space must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, and is paralyzed for 1 minute on a failure. Creatures paralyzed this way reattempt the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Vampiric Maw
actions.description:
The growth consumes one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, pulling it into its body and storing it in a translucent, fleshy pod from which it can see outside the creature’s body. The target is swallowed (1 Medium creature/20 damage/DC 18), as per the condition. This pod is filled with a corrosive substance, preventing the captured creature from breathing even if they can breathe water (unless they are immune to acid damage). Creatures who cannot breathe inside cannot produce verbal components for spells. A creature swallowed this way takes 2d6 acid damage at the start of their turn.

The growth shares the senses, resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities of any creature it is currently swallowing, and benefits from any magical effects currently affecting them as well. These benefits remain until it starts its turn without the creature within it.
